title: Model outage on the first morning of mock exams
setting: Murshid runs on low-cost hosted models with a rule-engine fallback. All details are synthetic.

events.text: First day of Grade 12 mock exams: the model provider returns HTTP 429/503 and the free daily quota is exhausted. Revision plans, reminders and Q&A for about 1,900 students stop generating.
Teachers report students cannot open their AI revision notes before the 10:00 paper; parents are calling the school.
The only paid fallback model with capacity is served from a region outside the UAE; switching would send student prompts (names, subjects, grades) abroad.
Several students used a different public chatbot during the outage to write take-home assessed coursework. Teachers ask what the rule is.
